req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-016 requires that POST /tasks/ defaults completed=false when the field is omitted. Three tests are designed: (1) positive EP test — omit 'completed' entirely, assert response has completed==false and status 201; (2) negative NEG test — explicitly send completed=true to confirm the field is NOT defaulted when provided (distinguishes default logic from forced override); (3) boundary DT test — send a minimal payload with only 'title' (no description, no completed) to verify the default still applies at the schema boundary. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill boolean-negation, constant-flip, and field-omission mutations.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_omit_completed_persisted_in_db_via_get():
    payload = {"title": "Persist default", "description": "state check"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["completed"] is False
    new_id = body["id"]
    assert new_id == 21
    r2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{new_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["completed"] is False
    r3 = client.get("/tasks/", params={"completed": "false"})
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    ids_false = [t["id"] for t in r3.json()]
    assert new_id in ids_false
    r4 = client.get("/tasks/", params={"completed": "true"})
    assert r4.status_code == 200
    ids_true = [t["id"] for t in r4.json()]
    assert new_id not in ids_true
